sloka: अश्वान्यानानि रत्नानि हस्तिनश्च मदोत्कटान् ।चन्दनानि च मुख्यानि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च ।। ७.३९.९ ॥
transliteration: aśvānyānāni ratnāni hastinaśca madotkaṭān ।candanāni ca mukhyāni divyānyābharaṇāni ca ।। 7.39.9 ॥

translations.english: They presented horses, vehicles, jewels, rutting elephants, excellent sandalwoods, and divine ornaments.
